lane:
زنجفر

زُنْجُفْرٌ _A certain dye,_ [or _pigment,_] _well known,_ (K,) _of a red colour, with which one writes as well as dyes;_ [namely, _cinnabar:_] its virtue is similar to that of white lead; or, as some say, of شَادَنْج [a kind of stone, used medicinally, from the Persian شَادْنَهْ]: it is of two kinds, _native_ and _factitious: the native is_ [_formed by_] _the transition of a sulphureous substance into quicksilver:_ [_it is a sulphureous ore of quicksilver:_] _the factitious_ [_is what is called vermilion, and_] _is of various sorts._ (TA.)
